content.short: Gryphon is a decentralized liquid staking and money market platform built on the Injective blockchain.
content.description:
Gryphon is a decentralized liquid staking derivative (LSD) platform and money market built natively on the Injective blockchain. It allows users to stake their assets, such as INJ, to receive liquid tokens like nINJ while continuing to earn network rewards. This approach unlocks capital efficiency, enabling users to participate in DeFi activities without losing their staking positions. Gryphon also features an integrated lending and borrowing protocol.

The platform's goal is to enhance the liquidity of staked assets within the Injective ecosystem, providing a robust suite of financial tools for its users. By combining liquid staking with money market features, Gryphon offers a comprehensive DeFi experience. It empowers the community to maximize their returns through secure and transparent on-chain mechanisms.
